snippet.title: BioMenace Remastered - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing BioMenace Remastered by Rigel Gameworks! Coming to Steam in Fall 2025. Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459100/BioMenace_Remastered 

The classic 2D run & gun action platformer by James Norwood is making a return - with enhanced graphics, refined gameplay, and many quality of life improvements. Includes all three original episodes plus a brand-new episode 4 - and a level editor!

Disclaimer: All game footage shown in this trailer represents work in progress. The final product may have differences in graphics, sound, and available features. The footage at the start of the video (until 0:10) is of the original (1993) DOS version of the game.

The remastered version offers:
• Enhanced graphics including widescreen support, smooth scrolling & movement (60 FPS or higher), and parallax scrolling backgrounds
• Modernized HUD & UI
• Switch between original and remastered graphics at any time
• Controller support
• Full Steam Deck support
• Rebalanced difficulty
• Gameplay tweaks and new mechanics, including weapon/grenade type switching and infinite lives, a kill streak system, and more
• Mid-level saves and quick saving
• Completion and stats tracking
• Steam achievements
• Built-in level editor
• Complete original soundtrack by Bobby Prince from the DOS version, plus brand new AdLib music by Myrgharok

Rigel Gameworks is a small independent development team led by Nikolai "lethal_guitar" Wuttke-Hohendorf, lead developer on Duke Nukem 1+2 Remastered for Evercade and author of RigelEngine.

Reveal trailer by Bart “Dosgamert” Remmers.
